subtitle: Flower Buns at New Year

object_reference.name: A Flower Bun
object_reference.note: The narrator recalls her grandmother steaming many Shandong flower buns (huamo) every Lunar New Year. The image is a representative symbol of this food tradition, not a photograph of the family’s own bun or a claim about its exact design.
